name: Kokkuri-san no Haka
source:
It was an accursed ritual...

Makino Akiko was a first-year junior high student.
When she and her 3 good friends committed a rite of passage,
they disturbed the grave of the Kokkuri...

What they experience next is more terrifying than death... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE066090.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
那是一场受诅咒的仪式……

牧野晶子是一名初中一年级学生。
她与三位好友举行通灵仪式时，惊扰了狐狗狸仙的坟墓……

随后等待她们的，是比死亡更加恐怖的经历……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE066090.html]DLsite[/url]]
